description:
The `gf2-algebra` README is the crate's concise adopter-facing entry page: what the crate provides, when to choose it, and where its reference material lives.

## Background

Permanent pages target researchers evaluating or adopting gf2 and assume technical competence. Explanatory prose is freshly authored; only independently verified code, commands, equations, identifiers and empirical data are reused from prior material. Pages state current supported behavior only. A crate README is the crate's entry page; the docs index links it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/gf2-algebra/README.md` states permanent and packed-field computation, backends, feature flags, and when to choose the crate, verified against the crate's current public API and Cargo manifest.
- [hard] REQ-02: Its prose and structure are freshly authored; reused items from `crates/gf2-algebra/README.md` are limited to verified code, commands and identifiers.
- [hard] REQ-03: It carries no performance figures, API walkthrough duplicating Rustdoc, hand-maintained example list, history, or future promises; it links to the crate's Rustdoc and to `docs/index.md`.
- [hard] REQ-04: It links to no file under a crate-local `docs/` directory.
- [hard] REQ-05: Its links and commands resolve, and the Rust CI gate passes.
title: Rewrite the gf2-algebra README as its entry page
